1934, July
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 202 Cont.
June 7 George Duford Cont ... Yesterday Ist Fr. went to Communion and is happy. (Memory restored at same time. Asks prayers now to get back to work)
10 Paul Austin - 37 - prayed for last week ... still missing ... Auto found in brush beyond, 10th. Found last Saturday - to have been murdered ... buried in Mt. Clemens ..
Rob. Savage - 33 - bursted, gangreenous appendix - very low To-day ... Enrolled at 10:35 a.m.
11 Owen Thompson - 22 - graduate from Annunciation four yrs ... no work discouraged ....
Robert Redden - 45 - of Buffalo, N.Y. - out of steady employ. - boy 6 dumb & Epil ....
Ella Keil - 47 - Lutherin ....
Eliz. Sweeney - 50 - T. B. of bone. Drs. want to amputate half of hand.
Edna May Gabrish
Page 203 July 11 Mabel Lecureux - 40 - non c. goiter
Edw'd Crookedacre - 11 - blind almost totally blind.
John Devine - 37 - shell-shocked since 15 yrs. Quite paralyzed - mind alert. Drs. gave him 2 yrs. to live 15 yrs. ago. Now say no hope of recovery.
Rob't Vandewalle - 4 - Ford Hosp. sore. .. seemingly pneumonia. En- rolled last evening for 2 yrs. This a.m. perpetual.
Eliz. Hagedorn - thanks for escape from operation for gall-stones. Miss Marin .... boarding ...
Dr. Weisner .... wants to move near
Marie Gibbel - 45 - pertenitis - daughter 18 husband now very low (phone
HelenNiezborski - 10 - deaf & dumb - can say. ..
